name: Cinderblade converts Intellect into critical strike rating and raises spell hit (#1187)
contract: Cinderblade 704959 reads 'Level 30 Passive. Increases your critical strike rating by 20% of your Intellect and your spell hit chance by 6%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Effect 0 is the native aura 220 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT), MiscValue 1792 (a CombatRating bitmask: (1<<CR_CRIT_MELEE)|(1<<CR_CRIT_RANGED)|(1<<CR_CRIT_SPELL) = 256+512+1024), MiscValueB 3 (STAT_INTELLECT), BasePoints 20. Player::UpdateRating (Entities/Unit/StatSystem.cpp) reads every SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT aura whose MiscValue bit matches the rating being recalculated and adds CalculatePct(GetStat(MiscValueB), GetAmount()) - a fully native, already-implemented conversion, so no bespoke stat hook is needed. Effect 1 is the native aura 55 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE), BasePoints 6.
